en.headline: Indefinite hospital order for man who killed two women at Plaza Hollywood
en.dek: Szeto Sing-kwong pleaded guilty to manslaughter by diminished responsibility after a 2023 stabbing attack; the High Court ordered him detained without limit of time.
body: A High Court judge on Tuesday ordered Szeto Sing-kwong, 43, to be detained in a psychiatric hospital without limit of time after he pleaded guilty to two counts of manslaughter by reason of diminished responsibility for killing two women at Plaza Hollywood in Diamond Hill in June 2023.

Madam Justice Esther Toh accepted that Szeto had been in an acute relapse of paranoid schizophrenia at the time of the attack. The prosecution did not pursue the original murder charges once the diminished-responsibility plea was accepted. The judge described the case as a tragedy and noted that Szeto continued to show limited insight into his illness.

Fong Hiu-tong, 26, and Lau Kai-hei, 22, were stabbed on the third floor of the shopping centre on 2 June 2023. Szeto remained at the scene, covered in blood, until a chef and others stopped him and police arrived. Psychiatric reports linked the attack to his mental state at the time.

zh.headline: 荷里活廣場斬人案被告認誤殺 被判無限期醫院令
zh.dek: 司徒成光以減責神志失常承認兩項誤殺罪，高等法院法官杜麗冰判處無限期醫院令，形容案件為悲劇。
body: 高等法院周二裁定43歲的司徒成光以減責神志失常為由承認兩項誤殺罪，法官杜麗冰判處他無限期醫院令，須接受強制精神科治療及監管。
控方接納被告當時處於妄想型思覺失調急性復發狀態，不再追究原先的謀殺控罪。法官形容事件屬悲劇，並指被告對自己的病情仍欠缺充分洞察。
兩名死者方曉彤（26歲）及劉繼禧（22歲）於2023年6月2日在鑽石山荷里活廣場三樓遇襲身亡。事後被告滿身血跡留在現場，直至一名廚師及市民合力制止，警方到場拘捕。精神科報告顯示襲擊與被告當時的精神狀態有關。
